attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 elderly 3
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 myagang-temple tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 adult 1
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter myagang-temple
load car1 adult 2
drive car1 myagang-temple tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 adult 2
defer tadi-farm adult 2
</plan>
COST: 120

I treated the two people at Tadi farm as 2 adults, since the report is ambiguous. Only Tarkeshwar shelter is a designated evacuation point, so everyone has to be brought back there. The closed Shivapuri–Gosaikunda road and the flooded Shivapuri–Benighat road are not used.

The car makes two round trips to Myagang temple, 40 minutes each, and rescues all six people there. Reaching Tadi farm would add 44 minutes of driving, which is more than the 40-point penalty for deferring those 2 adults, so I deferred them.
